name: Maritime Evasion: Flag Hopping, AIS Manipulation and Ship-to-Ship Transfers
description: Vessels linked to proliferation-sensitive trade may change flags, ownership and names, disable or falsify identification signals, and conduct cargo transfers at sea. Maritime due diligence uses vessel history, tracking data and ownership analysis to identify these behaviours without relying only on documents.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Counter Proliferation Financing (2018)
US Department of State, Department of the Treasury (OFAC) and US Coast Guard, Guidance to Address Illicit Shipping and Sanctions Evasion Practices (2020)
UN Security Council 1718 Committee Panel of Experts, Final Report (specify year; mandate ended April 2024)
